name: Soft Photo Gallery
author: Akash Ahmed

sections.description:
Soft Photo Gallery is a powerful and flexible WordPress plugin that allows you to create stunning photo galleries with ease. Whether you’re a photographer, artist, or business owner, this plugin provides everything you need to showcase your images professionally.

With multiple gallery styles, advanced customization options, and user-friendly features, Soft Photo Gallery helps you create beautiful, responsive galleries that work perfectly on any device and with any WordPress theme.

Key Features

  • 🎨 Multiple Gallery Styles: Choose from 6 different display styles including Grid, Masonry, List, Slider, Justified, and Spotlight views
  • 🔍 Search & Filtering: Enable frontend search to help visitors find specific images quickly
  • 📝 Image Captions: Add descriptive captions that display on hover or in slideshow mode
  • 📱 Fully Responsive: Galleries automatically adapt to different screen sizes and devices
  • 🎯 Social Sharing: Allow visitors to share images on Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest
  • ⚡ Fast & Lightweight: Optimized for performance without slowing down your website
  • 🛠️ Easy Management: Simple interface for adding and organizing gallery images
  • 🔄 Auto-Save: Optional auto-save feature for your gallery settings
  • 📤 Import/Export: Backup and transfer your gallery settings between sites
  • 🎛️ Customizable Settings: Extensive options to match your website’s design

Perfect For

  • Photographers showcasing portfolios
  • Artists displaying their work
  • Businesses showing product images
  • Bloggers creating image-rich content
  • Anyone needing a professional image gallery

🔥 Features

Gallery Styles

  • Grid View: Clean, organized grid layout
  • Masonry View: Pinterest-style cascading layout
  • List View: Sequential list with image descriptions
  • Slider Carousel: Interactive slideshow with navigation
  • Justified View: Balanced rows with varying image heights
  • Spotlight View: Featured image with supporting thumbnails

Customization Options

  • Show/hide search functionality
  • Enable/disable image captions
  • Social sharing buttons
  • Slideshow auto-rotation
  • Customizable slideshow intervals
  • Hover effects and animations

Management Tools

  • Auto-save settings
  • Export settings to JSON file
  • Import settings from backup
  • Reset to default settings
  • SweetAlert confirmations for actions

📚 Installation

  1. Upload the soft-photo-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘Photo Galleries’ in your WordPress admin to create your first gallery
  4. Use the provided shortcode to display galleries on any page or post

📖 How to Use

Creating a Gallery

  1. Go to Photo Galleries → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Give your gallery a title
  3. Click Add Images to upload or select images from your media library
  4. Add descriptions for each image (optional)
  5. Configure gallery settings:
    • Choose your preferred gallery style
    • Enable/disable slideshow for slider view
    • Set slideshow interval (if enabled)
    • Show/hide search functionality
    • Enable/disable image captions
    • Add social sharing buttons
  6. Publish your gallery

Displaying Galleries

Use the shortcode provided in the gallery editor or use:

[photo_gallery id="123"]

Replace “123” with your actual gallery ID. You can also add additional parameters:

  • style – Override the default gallery style
  • search – Enable/disable search (true/false)
  • slideshow – Enable/disable slideshow (true/false)

Example: [photo_gallery id="123" style="masonry" search="true"]

Managing Settings

  1. Go to Photo Galleries → Tools to access plugin settings
  2. Configure default gallery style and global options
  3. Use the Tools section to:
    • Enable auto-save for settings
    • Export your current settings
    • Import settings from another site
    • Reset all settings to defaults

Additional Information

Contributions:
We welcome contributions! If you’d like to contribute to the development of Soft Photo Gallery, please check out the GitHub repository.

Privacy:
This plugin does not collect any user data or personal information. All gallery data is stored locally on your WordPress site.

Credits:
Thanks to all contributors and users who have helped improve Soft Photo Gallery through their feedback and suggestions.
sections.faq:
Does Soft Photo Gallery work with all WordPress themes?

Yes! The plugin is designed to be fully compatible with all modern WordPress themes and is completely responsive.

Can I customize the gallery colors and styling?

Yes, you can customize the appearance through CSS. The plugin uses semantic class names for easy styling.

Is the gallery mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! All gallery styles are fully responsive and will look great on mobile devices, tablets, and desktops.

How many images can I add to a gallery?

There’s no hard limit. You can add as many images as you need, though very large galleries may require optimization for best performance.

Can I use multiple galleries on the same page?

Yes, you can use multiple gallery shortcodes on the same page without any conflicts.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No coding knowledge required! The plugin is designed to be user-friendly with an intuitive interface.

Is there a pro version available?

Currently, all features are available in the free version. Future updates may include premium features.
